source: CLAIM 2024 Update, Radiology: Artificial Intelligence 2024;6(4):e240300, doi:10.1148/ryai.240300 (item titles only; read the full guideline for the complete wording)

items.1: Identification as a study of AI methodology, specifying the category of technology used (eg, deep learning)
items.2: Summary of study design, methods, results, and conclusions
items.3: Scientific and/or clinical background, including the intended use and role of the AI approach
items.4: Study aims, objectives, and hypotheses (if not a data-driven approach)
items.14: Definition of method(s) used to obtain the reference standard
items.15: Rationale for choosing the reference standard
items.18: Measures of inter- and intrarater variability of features described by the annotators
items.19: How data were assigned to partitions
items.20: Level at which partitions are disjoint
items.26: Method of selecting the final model
items.29: Statistical measures of significance and uncertainty
items.35: Numbers of patients or examinations included and excluded
items.36: Demographic and clinical characteristics of cases in each partition and dataset
items.37: Performance metrics and measures of statistical uncertainty
items.38: Estimates of diagnostic performance and their precision
items.41: Implications for practice, including intended use and/or clinical role
items.42: Provide a reference to the full study protocol or to additional technical details
items.43: Statement about the availability of software, trained model, and/or data
items.44: Sources of funding and other support; role of funders
